transcript.text: Hi everyone, thanks for being here. We've got 30 kilograms of apples from the orchard to sort this weekend into three categories: family use, community pantry donation, and freezer storage. Before I make the final call on the split, let's go around the table like we usually do so each of you can share any practical details that should shape the plan. We've got clean one-kilogram boxes, freezer containers, labels, and a kitchen scale ready to go. Who'd like to start?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I spoke with Grandma yesterday, and she specifically asked for exactly 6 kilograms of the apples to be peeled and cooked into unsweetened applesauce because chewing whole apples is difficult for her. I wanted to make sure the group knows this before we decide on the split.
